s01e001.title: A Shimmering Surprise in Glimmer Meadow
s01e001.premise: Juni tries to gather bright berries for a snack, but the berries tumble down the hill. With her friends' help she learns to wait and plan, and a gentle glow appears in the meadow. The shining lights show how small kindness can brighten the whole valley.
